prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Flow Reorder: Move sign-in to take place after pet choice and customization so users build an emotional bond before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage-Based Companion Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring animated companion previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your Future Desktop Friend", "body": "Select a companion to keep you company while you work and play."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen: Add a dedicated visual controls screen before completing onboarding showing key shortcuts for hiding and summoning the pet.
   config: {"new_controls_overview": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Use quick keyboard shortcuts or the top tray icon to interact with your pet anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Press Alt+P to toggle pet visibility", "style": "plain"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Room Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a mini carousel flow featuring interactive tips and companion backstory tidbits during generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's New Home", "body": "Your companion is getting ready! Swipe through tips on how to interact with them."}}
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Tip: Provide clear photo formatting guidance on the upload screen to ensure pet rendering succeeds.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, forward-facing photos with good lighting for optimal pet generation results."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Save Protection Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to emphasize that signing in prevents pet data loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sync & Protect Your Pet Progress", "body": "Sign in so your companion's memory, items, and growth stay safe across restarts."}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Notification: Enable desktop notifications when pet loading finishes so users who switch windows know when to return.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout Path Choice: Switch the choose_path layout to a side-by-side grid format to clearly contrast preset vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Begin"}}
8: [finish, incentive] Companion Unlock Badge Incentive: Add a celebratory badge component to the final screen acknowledging full setup completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Companion Ready for Action!", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Progress Visualizer: Display step progress indicators and step counters on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet customization is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.
Redesigns pet selection screen while preserving its core function.
Adding a new controls overview screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen into a carousel maintains its core job of showing pet preparation.
Adds clear guidance to the photo upload screen without violating any rules.
Updates sign-in copy to explain progress saving without using unfair design practices.
Adding desktop notification options to the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.
Redesigns choose_path layout to grid while retaining both creation paths.
Adds a completion badge to home_intro inside onboarding, which is permitted.
Adds step visualizer indicators to adoption certificate screen while preserving its function.
